findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sample_verification_report, get_israeli_company_changes_paid · Private data: get_sample_verification_report, preview_agent_payment_trust, preview_israeli_invoice_payment_gate_free · Public sink: verify_company, verify_israeli_company_paid, assess_israeli_vendor_payment_risk_paid, authorize_israeli_invoice_payment_paid, get_israeli_company_changes_paid · Destructive: preview_agent_payment_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sample_verification_report, get_israeli_company_changes_paid · Private data: get_sample_verification_report, preview_agent_payment_trust, preview_israeli_invoice_payment_gate_free · Public sink: verify_company, verify_israeli_company_paid, assess_israeli_vendor_payment_risk_paid, authorize_israeli_invoice_payment_paid, get_israeli_company_changes_paid · Destructive: preview_agent_payment_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
